text:
Liam: Heads up — saw a big SSE cost spike in eu-west around 09:12, console shows token_count jump ~2.4x in 30s. Seems tied to a burst of resume events from one tenant.
Maria: on it. which metric trace?
Liam: per-route token_count (eu-west-1) + streaming_resume_count. timeline lines up. https://console.redwood.internal/d/streams/tenant/acme
Anya: we did lower idle-timeout on the edge proxy earlier today — could cause quick reconnects before the server fully releases session.
Samir: oncall here — I saw a cluster of 502/504s on the proxy around that time too. grabbing traces. :mag:
watchdog-bot: alert: tenant=acme, stream_resume_rate=530/min, token_rate=1.2M/min
Maria: quick hypothesis: billing path increments both on session close AND on resume accept. short reconnect (<2s) ends up double-counted. need to verify idempotency.
Anya: iirc there's an "allow_resume_charge" flag in session-service. a PR changed semantics last quarter to treat ws vs sse differently.
Samir: pulling logs for session_id=abc123 -> close -> resume -> accept sequence. found both close_charge and resume_charge events in the same trace.
Maria: ok that's our smoking gun. Proposed emergency mitigation: server-side dedupe by resume_token within a short window (5s). cheap and reversible.
Liam: also want better telemetry: tag resume events with reconcile=true/false so console can surface raw vs deduped counts. ops need both views.
Anya: agree on both. i'll open a small PR that adds a dedupe gate and emits resume_charge_deduped=true metric and a new resume_charge_dedup_ratio gauge.
Samir: i'll own rollout. prefer staged rollout: staging -> 5% canary -> global. billing logic so be conservative.
deploy-bot: deploy started: session-service/hotfix/dedupe (staging) by Anya — build 2345
watchdog-bot: metric suggestion logged: resume_charge_dedup_ratio (per-tenant, per-region)
Maria: console UX note — charts currently show token_count and resume_count but not deduped vs raw. i'd like an annotation layer & an alert if dedup_ratio spikes during rollout.
Liam: also add quick repro script so we can validate in staging.
Maria: repro paste: ```bash
# reproduce quick reconnects
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -N -H "Resume-Token: tkn-123" https://eu.api.redwood/v1/stream || true
  sleep 1
done
```
Anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/session-service/pull/789 — adds token+5s dedupe and exports resume_charge_deduped, resume_charge_dedup_ratio.
Samir: deploying to staging now, monitoring token_count, resume_count, resume_charge_dedup_ratio.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to staging (session-service/hotfix/dedupe build 2345)
Samir: staging looks clean, no regressions on connection latency. canary scheduled: 5% in 10m.
Liam: suggest adding an alert tweak: fire if resume_charge_dedup_ratio > 0.05 for 2m during canary, so we catch unexpected behavior without noise.
Maria: created alert: https://console.redwood.internal/alerts/12345 — owner: billing-team.
Anya: assigning owners in PR: Anya (code), Samir (rollout), Maria (billing validation), Liam (console + telemetry).
Samir: noted. will update thread with canary results. if dedup_ratio > 0.2 we stop and postmortem.
Liam: thanks all. after canary we'll decide final dedupe window (5s vs 2s) and whether to make it opt-in per-tenant. :thumbsup:
